statement: Between 2026-08-11 and 2026-08-31, Ukrainian forces strike at least one oil refinery or oil processing facility on Russian territory, corroborated by at least two international news organizations.
resolution: At least two international news organizations (e.g. Reuters, AFP, BBC) report a Ukrainian strike hitting a named Russian oil refinery or oil processing facility occurring between 2026-08-11 and 2026-08-31.
failure_condition: No Ukrainian strike on any Russian oil refinery or oil processing facility between 2026-08-11 and 2026-08-31 is corroborated by two international news organizations.

statement: ICE Brent crude front-month futures settle above 110.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-11.
resolution: Official ICE Brent front-month daily settlement price exceeds 110.00 USD on any trading day between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-11, per ICE settlement records.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month daily settlement between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-11 is at or below 110.00 USD.

statement: The FOMC leaves the federal funds target range unchanged at its scheduled meeting concluding 2026-09-16.
resolution: The Federal Reserve implementation note and FOMC statement of 2026-09-16 announce a target range identical to the range in effect on 2026-08-10.
failure_condition: The 2026-09-16 FOMC statement announces a target range different from the range in effect on 2026-08-10.

statement: Intel prices or completes a common stock offering of at least 10 billion USD between 2026-08-11 and 2026-10-30, per filings on SEC EDGAR.
resolution: SEC EDGAR shows an Intel Corporation prospectus supplement, 424B, or 8-K filed between 2026-08-11 and 2026-10-30 pricing or completing a common stock offering with gross proceeds of at least 10 billion USD.
failure_condition: No Intel filing on SEC EDGAR in the window prices or completes a common stock offering of at least 10 billion USD.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog contains at least one CVE affecting Progress LoadMaster or SonicWall SMA1000 with a dateAdded value between 2026-08-01 and 2026-08-21.
resolution: A fetch of the CISA KEV catalog JSON shows at least one entry whose product field matches LoadMaster or SMA1000 and whose dateAdded falls between 2026-08-01 and 2026-08-21 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry for LoadMaster or SMA1000 carries a dateAdded value between 2026-08-01 and 2026-08-21.

statement: A US House committee or subcommittee holds a hearing between 2026-09-01 and 2026-12-18 at which an OpenAI or Anthropic executive testifies about the reported AI company security breach.
resolution: Congress.gov or official House committee records list a hearing held between 2026-09-01 and 2026-12-18 with a witness from OpenAI or Anthropic addressing the breach.
failure_condition: No House hearing in the window features testimony from an OpenAI or Anthropic witness concerning the breach.

statement: The Israeli government formally announces acceptance of the US-backed 15-point Gaza plan or a publicly identified revision of it between 2026-08-11 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: At least two international news organizations report an official Israeli government announcement, made between 2026-08-11 and 2026-10-30, accepting the US-backed Gaza plan or a named revision.
failure_condition: No official Israeli acceptance of the US-backed Gaza plan or a named revision is announced within the window.

statement: USGS catalogs at least one M6.0 or greater earthquake with epicenter within 200 km of event us6000tjl2 and origin time between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-10 UTC.
resolution: The USGS earthquake catalog lists an event of magnitude 6.0 or higher, epicenter within 200 km of USGS event us6000tjl2, origin time between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-10 UTC.
failure_condition: The USGS catalog shows no M6.0 or greater event within 200 km of us6000tjl2 with origin time in the window.

statement: The official cumulative death toll for the 2026 Assam floods reaches or exceeds 150 on or before 2026-09-10.
resolution: Assam State Disaster Management Authority figures, or at least two international news organizations citing official figures, report a cumulative 2026 Assam flood death toll of 150 or more by 2026-09-10.
failure_condition: Official cumulative death toll figures for the 2026 Assam floods remain below 150 through 2026-09-10.

statement: Daniel Kinahan remains remanded in custody in Ireland, with no court ordering his release on bail, from 2026-08-10 through 2026-10-30.
resolution: MISS if any Irish court orders Kinahan released on bail on or before 2026-10-30 per court reporting by at least two news organizations; HIT if he remains in custody through that date.
failure_condition: An Irish court orders Kinahan released on bail on or before 2026-10-30.
